sanitizer.scope: Existing native CTests and isolated instrumentation control only

limitations: The unfinished T1/T2/T3 fuzzing campaign is not run by this command.
ASan, when requested, covers existing native tests only; no generated oracle coverage or held-back fuzz variants.
No new ten-minute performance or multi-hour endurance measurement.
This subset does not replace the full CI UI/accessibility or native build matrix.
Local unsigned evidence is not attestation; outside-range/between-sample changes may be missed.

provenance: Isolated local snapshot; original repository not committed or pushed. Same Windows host and download caches; not an independent-machine test.
